messages:
IncidentBot: INCIDENT 4823456789 — spike in GPU decode OOMs (us-west-2). Automatic paging triggered. Affected service: /v1/decode-stream (hosted).

Sasha (oncall): Seen it, joining. Seeing a bunch of CUDA OOMs and container restarts in the decode pool. Node flaps ~3 nodes in last 2 mins.

MJ: Copy — can you share the top error from the runtime logs?

Sasha (oncall): Pasting tail of one failing container log:
```
[2026-03-15T02:12:14Z] ERROR runtime.decode: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory (cuMemAlloc)
[2026-03-15T02:12:14Z] WARN runtime.stream: KV cache growth spike: seq_len 4096 -> 8192 in one request
[2026-03-15T02:12:14Z] ERROR container.manager: process exited: SIGKILL
```

Elaine (infra): Node metrics show memory pressure on g4dn-like instances, GPU mem staying pinned after some kills -> potential leak or runaway generation. Also surface-level network backoffs between agent and orchestration.

Samir (runtime): Hypothesis: a client is sending unbounded generation (header mismatch on max_tokens), decoder not enforcing per-request token cap early enough -> KV cache growth -> OOM. We have a slow path where enforcement happens late during decode.

Alex (support): Any customer impact? Any tickets?

Sasha (oncall): Initial telemetry: ~2.4% of decode-stream requests in us-west-2 returned 5xx or were dropped in the past 10m. Affected tenants: 3 high-usage customers intermittently seeing truncated responses. Opening a customer-impact channel and notifying account owners now.

MJ: Immediate mitigations: 1) enforce a hard token ceiling at the ingress LB for decode-stream requests (global override to 1024), 2) enable temporary decode-kill-on-growth flag in runtime (kills request when KV > 2048), 3) scale decode pool +2 nodes. Which can we do fastest?

Elaine (infra): I can scale the pool now (autoscaler override) and apply the LB override (nginx config) — will push in 30s.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: nginx-config/ingress-hard-cap -> canary -> us-west-2.

Sasha (oncall): While canarying, I'll enable throttles at the routing layer for any single client exceeding 10 concurrent streams. Also enabling per-tenant quarantine for the top offender observed in logs (client_id=cust-42).

Samir (runtime): I'll flip runtime flag runtime.config: { "decode.kv_hard_limit": 2048, "decode.kv_kill_mode": "eager" } on the canary runtime group. Patch will reject runaway streams earlier. Rolling to 5% of nodes first.

Elaine (infra): Scale +2 nodes done. Nginx override pushed to canary group. Verifying metrics.

MJ: Good. Also enable fallback routing: route requests above 800 tokens to smaller model (quantized) for now to reduce per-request memory. Samir, can runtime support model fallback automatically?

Samir (runtime): Yes, adding a routing rule: if request max_tokens > 800 OR observed kv > 1024, route to model: redwood-mini-quantized-v1. This will be added to the smart-router policy for the region. Applying in parallel.

Sasha (oncall): After canary checks (3 mins) we'll roll changes. Early metrics: OOM rate in canary group dropped ~70%. Overall 5xx rate falling from 2.4% -> 0.8% in last 6 mins.

Alex (support): Notifying customers: sending templated note to affected account owners (cust-42, cust-71, cust-88) with ETA ~15m for full mitigation.

MJ: Assign follow-ups: postmortem owner? Samir you own the runtime code patch. Elaine own infra root cause. Sasha write incident timeline and customer summary. Alex coordinate customer comms.

Samir (runtime): On it. Initial plan for root cause: add earlier enforcement for max_tokens at ingress AND add KV accounting to detect growth trends per-step. Also audit recent model updates that could increase kv footprint.

Sasha (oncall): Quick note: we saw a header parity issue where some SDK versions omitted client-side max_tokens header, falling back to server defaults that are not enforced until decode. Need to add schema validation in the API layer.

deploy-bot: rollout: nginx-config/ingress-hard-cap -> canary succeeded. runtime-flag/runtime-config -> 5% rollout succeeded. smart-router/rule -> applied to us-west-2 canary nodes.

Elaine (infra): Observability: collected coredumps from one crashed container; uploading to S3 (s3://redwood-incident-dumps/4823456789/). GPU driver logs included.

Sasha (oncall): Status update: OOM spike contained. Rolling full runtime-config and router rule to region in 10m if no regressions. Customer impact: intermittent truncated responses for ~12 minutes, then degradation during the 15 minutes prior to mitigations.

Alex (support): Sent interim customer notes. Two accounts asked for a timeline of root cause and compensation info — flagged for success.

MJ: After action items: 1) enforce max_tokens at API-gateway, 2) backfill telemetry for per-request kv growth, 3) automated quarantine for runaway client patterns, 4) retro on SDK header mismatch, 5) add regression tests for decode memory leak scenarios. Samir/Elaine/Sasha assigned.

Samir (runtime): Quick debug snippet attached that helped identify the offending request (logged client_id + token count):
```
{ "client_id": "cust-42", "request_id": "req-4823-xyz", "requested_max_tokens": null, "observed_steps": 9300, "kv_peak": 9216 }
```

Sasha (oncall): Closing note: escalating to RFC for adding a fail-closed schema check at the edge. Will create postmortem doc and link here.

Alex (support): I'll follow up with customers with the postmortem link when ready.

IncidentBot: INCIDENT 4823456789 status: mitigated -> monitoring.

Sasha (oncall): Marking as resolved for pager. Retaining for postmortem work items.
